subject: The 3-minute habit that halves healing time
preview_text: Day 37: One simple habit that makes your healing 10x faster, proven by 600+ users.
body_paragraphs: At 2AM, I was lying in bed, replaying the breakup for the hundredth time. I grabbed my phone, opened the app, and did one thing that changed everything: a 3-minute breathing exercise. It wasn't magic, but it stopped the spiral. That night, I slept 6 hours straight for the first time in weeks.

Here's the truth: consistency, not intensity, is what rebuilds you. A 3-minute routine—daily check-in, one gratitude entry, and a single mood log—makes this app 10x more effective than using it for an hour once a week. Our data shows users who do this for 7 days see a 40% faster drop in obsessive thoughts. You don't need to fix everything tonight. You just need to show up for 3 minutes.

That's why we built the streak tracker. Every day you complete your 3-minute routine, it logs your progress and sends a small nudge when you hit milestones. It's not about perfection; it's about building the identity of someone who heals. The app's coping strategies also adapt to your mood, so even on bad days, you get the right support.

Open the app now and start your 3-minute routine. It's right there on the home screen, waiting. P.S. The first time you hit a 7-day streak, the AI therapist shares a personalized insight about your healing pattern—it's like a secret you earn. See you inside.
